content.rendered:
DESTINY MESSENGERS

“And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.”
(1 Samuel 10: 26)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In a bid to establish Saul as King, there was a band of men whose hearts were touched by God, and they followed Saul. Saul didn’t have a band of men before he became king, but when God chose him to lead Israel, God also touched some men to support Saul’s success.

Friend, hear God’s prophetic word: God will touch men to assist you to make progress this year. God will touch men to open doors for you and push you to the next level; God will plant it in the heart of strangers and acquaintances to favour you; God will compel men to play positive roles that will help your advancement this year; God will touch men to do for you what you may not be able to do for yourself.

Saul didn’t beg the band of men to follow him; God just touched their hearts and they acted accordingly. This year, people you haven’t begged for anything will favour you at God’s instance. People you may not share a relationship with will be touched by God and without asking them for favours, they will favour immensely.

In the past, you may have asked men to favour you; this year, God will touch their hearts on your behalf. Some men may have stony hearts and will never willingly choose to help anyone, but when God touches them, they won’t have any option but to serve you effectively.

God was the architect of Saul’s kingship, and He made men available to make the project succeed. If God is at the center of your life this year, He will command men to work for your Exceeding Expansion.

Ask God to open your eyes to the men He has touched to favour you. Ask God to compel the men He has touched to act quickly in your best interest.

Pray With Me: Lord, touch the hearts of men to work in my favour, in Jesus’ name!
